One caveat worth flagging: the broker's summary contained no reported financial figures (revenue, earnings, cash flow), so my `key_figures` list was empty — the decision rested on price, volume, and the absence of pending corporate actions rather than on any fundamental data, and I did not invent figures to fill that field.
